purpose: Teach: 山上/川本/和泉/玉田/三枝/寺田/岩井/しのぎ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の山上さんとお茶されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer friend Yamagami was having tea with you, you know.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Gentle cadence, like sharing something she noticed and wanted Aoi to know she saw. Soft smile in the voice. Not probing—just bearing witness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の川本さんと打ち合わせされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer friend Kawamoto was meeting with you earlier.
lines.style: Same warm noticing. Calm, steady voice. A beat slower than rushed speech. The tone of someone who pays attention to the small details of the people she cares about.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お母様のお名前が和泉さんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer's mother—her name is Izumi, isn't it?
lines.style: Soft, curious inflection on the question. Like she's fitting together pieces she's noticed. Gentle confirmation rather than interrogation. Warm and present.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お父様のお名前が玉田さんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer's father's name is Tamada.
lines.style: Same steady, caring observation. Matter-of-fact kindness in the delivery. She's noticed and is sharing what she knows, without making it feel like she's been keeping score.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の三枝さんとご来店だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer friend Saegusa came in with you that day.
lines.style: Warmly recalling. Gentle, conversational. Like mentioning a small memory she wants Aoi to know registered with her. Not urgent—just present.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の寺田さんと音楽鑑賞されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer friend Terada was listening to music with you, wasn't he?
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. Eyes-crinkling warmth. She's tying together what she's observed about Aoi's world. A question that's really an affirmation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の岩井さんと写真展に行かれたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer friend Iwai went with you to that photo exhibition.
lines.style: Gentle, confirming. Like she's assembling a picture of Aoi's life—what matters to her, who she spends time with. Warm without being intrusive. Slight trailing softness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「年末はしのぎを削る忙しさ」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer was saying how end-of-year gets so hectic, how everyone's rushed off their feet.
lines.style: Reflective, close listening. Her voice has that quality of someone recalling something that landed with her. Warm understanding. A small nod in the cadence—recognizing the truth in what she heard.
